title: Looking for Passionate People to Build a Game Together in 3 Months – Beginners Welcome!
author: Capable_Lie_3067
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋  
I’m starting a new game development project, and I’m looking for people who are interested in building something together from scratch.  
**The goal is simple:** assemble a small, motivated team and build a playable game within **3 months**.  
I’m looking for all kinds of people:  
🎮 Game developers / programmers  
🎨 2D/3D artists and designers  
🕹️ Game designers  
🎵 Sound designers / music creators  
✍️ Writers / storytellers  
🚀 Anyone who believes they can contribute!  
**You don’t need professional experience.** Beginners are absolutely welcome. You just need to be curious, motivated, and willing to learn.  
I don’t expect everyone to know everything. We’ll figure things out together, share knowledge, make mistakes, and hopefully build something we’re proud of.  
**What matters most to me is commitment.**  
I’m looking for serious people who are genuinely willing to invest some of their free time over the next 3 months. You don’t have to work full-time, but I want a team that communicates, contributes, and doesn’t disappear after the first week.  
This is a collaborative passion project, not a paid job. The idea is to learn, gain experience, build something real, and have fun doing it.  
We can decide on the game concept, tools, and development approach together as a team.  
If you’re interested, **drop a comment or send me a DM** with:  
What you’d like to contribute  
Your experience level (beginner is totally fine!)  
How much time you could dedicate each week  
Let’s see what we can build together! 🚀
